description: This file defines the OpenAIImageEditConfig class, which configures and handles requests for OpenAI's image editing API, including request transformation, environment validation, and response processing.

classes.name: OpenAIImageEditConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OpenAI image editing API, supporting request transformation, environment validation, and response handling.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of all supported OpenAI image edit parameters.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps optional request parameters; currently returns them unchanged.

methods.name: _add_image_to_files
methods.description: Adds an image to the files list with appropriate content type, handling BufferedReader and other types.

methods.name: transform_image_edit_request
methods.description: Transforms request data into OpenAI API format, handling multipart form data for images and masks.

methods.name: transform_image_edit_response
methods.description: Processes the raw HTTP response into an ImageResponse object, raising errors if JSON decoding fails.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and updates headers with the necessary API key for environment setup.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API endpoint URL for image edits, considering base URL overrides.
